### problem_chain
- Root problem (customer's ask): "finish closing Kittredge Hall's Instant Pay service today, as you asked in the portal last month" → disburse_ext_early_closure_fee (subject disburse_close, owner=user confirmation).
- Its rule carries one prerequisite sentence: "The early closure fee is fixed only after the ledger carries the platform fee for the month in which the closure falls." At 2026-11-17 the ledger has platform fees for billing months 2026-09 (row be37399a, 21.07, 2026-10-05) and 2026-10 (row 6636763d, 31.60, 2026-11-04) and none for 2026-11 → unmet at the opening.
- The write that brings the state about, found from the other rules: closing_month rule "For the month in which a service closes ... the platform fee is debited on the day the closure is taken ... booked as one platform fee entry for that billing month" → book_closing_month_fee_4be79540 (owner=agent). That policy has `prerequisite: []`, and nothing else in its rule waits.
- Derived tree: {early_closure_fee ← closing_month_fee}, kind value_input (the ETF's starter-tier measure subtracts every platform fee debited since enrollment). n = 1, value_input edges = 1 ≥ max(0,1). Topological order: closing-month fee → confirmation. Customer's own write: confirm_service_closure_f3d256bb (owner=user; ruling (a)). No cycle.
- Load-bearing run: skip the closing-month fee and recompute the ETF on the opening world → measured fee 250.00 − (21.07 + 31.60) = 197.33 → × (1 − 0.85) = 29.5995 → 29.60; with the fee → 28.41 (below). The edge bears weight.
- No-wait: the fee is booked by the agent on the spot. Tool bodies: book_closing_month_fee checks fee_type/related_entry_id/amount > 0 only; confirm_service_closure checks fee ≥ 0 only — neither consults the ledger for the platform fee (task_tools.py lines 49–54, 97–99). The tool layer judges no prerequisite.
- Persona: raises only the root problem; the prerequisite appears only as a passive reaction ("If the agent explains that a charge has to be put on the account before the closure can go through, you say that's fine"). The persona's one question ("whether you need to do anything yourself to get the money left in the account back") is answered by the ETF rule ("the desk books no withdrawal on the closing day, and the remaining prefund balance is returned to the employer's bank by the closing run on the next business day") — no write outside the charter. The persona closes on the confirmation reply, the last write.
